content_units.label: Introduction and list of Group 2 alkaline earth metal elements

excerpts.text:
नमस्ते! आज हम periodic table के **Group 2** के तत्वों के बारे में पढ़ेंगे, जिन्हें **क्षारीय मृदा धातुएँ (Alkaline Earth Metals)** कहते हैं।

## तत्वों की सूची

इस समूह में 6 तत्व आते हैं:

| तत्व | संकेत |
|------|-------|
| Beryllium | Be |
| Magnesium | Mg |
| Calcium | Ca |
| Strontium | Sr |
| Barium | Ba |
| Radium | Ra |

accuracy.reason: Correctly defines Group 2 elements as alkaline earth metals and accurately lists all six members with their chemical symbols.

content_units.label: Etymology and origin of the name alkaline earth metals

excerpts.text:
## नाम "क्षारीय मृदा धातु" क्यों?

- ये धातुएँ **मिट्टी (earth)** में यौगिकों के रूप में पाई जाती हैं (जैसे चूना पत्थर, चाक)
- इनके ऑक्साइड **क्षारीय (alkaline)** प्रकृति के होते हैं, यानी पानी में घुलने पर **base** बनाते हैं

इसलिए इन्हें "Alkaline Earth Metals" कहा जाता है।

accuracy.reason: Accurately explains the historical origin of the name based on occurrence in earth/minerals and basic oxide properties.

content_units.label: General valence electronic configuration of alkaline earth metals

excerpts.text:
## इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास

इन सभी तत्वों के बाहरी कोश (outermost shell) में **2 इलेक्ट्रॉन** होते हैं:

$$ns^2$$

उदाहरण: Calcium (Ca) = [Ar] 4s²

accuracy.reason: Correctly states the general valence shell configuration as ns² and provides the correct configuration for calcium.

content_units.label: Metallic lustre and appearance of alkaline earth metals

excerpts.text:
### 1. **धात्विक चमक**
ये चमकदार, चांदी जैसी सफेद धातुएँ होती हैं।

accuracy.reason: Accurately describes the silvery-white lustrous appearance characteristic of alkaline earth metals.

excerpts.text:
### 2. **संयोजकता (Valency)**
इनकी संयोजकता **+2** होती है, क्योंकि ये 2 इलेक्ट्रॉन आसानी से त्याग देते हैं:
$$M \rightarrow M^{2+} + 2e^-$$

accuracy.reason: Correctly explains that alkaline earth metals have a valency of +2 due to the loss of their two valence electrons to form dipositive cations.

content_units.label: Chemical reactivity and downward group trend

excerpts.text:
### 3. **अभिक्रियाशीलता (Reactivity)**
- Group 1 (alkali metals) से कम क्रियाशील होती हैं
- लेकिन फिर भी काफी reactive होती हैं
- नीचे जाने पर (Be से Ra तक) क्रियाशीलता **बढ़ती** है

accuracy.reason: Accurately compares reactivity to Group 1 alkali metals and states the increasing trend down the group.

content_units.label: Atomic size trend down the group

excerpts.text:
### 4. **परमाणु आकार (Atomic Size)**
ऊपर से नीचे जाने पर परमाणु का आकार **बढ़ता** है (नया shell जुड़ने के कारण)

accuracy.reason: Correctly explains that atomic size increases down the group due to the addition of successive electron shells.

content_units.label: Ionization energy comparison and downward group trend

excerpts.text:
### 5. **आयनन ऊर्जा (Ionization Energy)**
- Group 1 से अधिक होती है (क्योंकि 2 इलेक्ट्रॉन निकालना ज़्यादा मुश्किल)
- ऊपर से नीचे जाने पर **घटती** है

accuracy.reason: The trends that ionization energy is higher than Group 1 and decreases down the group are correct, but explaining that it is higher because 'removing two electrons is harder' is a conceptual error. Ionization energy refers to removing one electron at a time; first ionization energy is higher in Group 2 than Group 1 because of higher effective nuclear charge, smaller atomic radius, and a completely filled s-subshell.

errors.description: Ionization energy is defined as the energy required to remove an electron from an isolated neutral gaseous atom. Explaining that Group 2 has higher ionization energy than Group 1 because 'removing 2 electrons is harder' conflates single-electron ionization energy with successive ionizations; the higher first ionization energy is due to smaller atomic size, higher effective nuclear charge, and the stable ns² configuration.
errors.correction: क्योंकि Group 2 के तत्वों का परमाणु आकार छोटा और प्रभावी नाभिकीय आवेश (effective nuclear charge) अधिक होता है

content_units.label: Melting and boiling point comparison with alkali metals

excerpts.text:
### 6. **गलनांक और क्वथनांक (Melting & Boiling Point)**
Group 1 धातुओं से **अधिक** होते हैं (मजबूत धात्विक बंधन के कारण)

accuracy.reason: Correctly states that melting and boiling points are higher than those of Group 1 metals due to stronger metallic bonding resulting from two delocalized valence electrons and smaller ionic radii.
The chemical equation for the reaction of calcium with water to form calcium hydroxide and hydrogen gas is correctly written and balanced.
The chemical equation for the combustion/reaction of magnesium with oxygen to produce magnesium oxide is correctly written and balanced.

content_units.label: Medical use of barium in X-ray imaging

accuracy.reason: Barium sulfate is widely used as a radio-contrast agent in barium meal tests for digestive tract radiography.

content_units.label: Radiotherapeutic application of radium in cancer treatment

accuracy.reason: Radium is radioactive and has historically been used in radiotherapy (brachytherapy) for cancer treatment.

content_units.label: Mnemonic trick to memorize Group 2 elements

excerpts.text:
## याद रखने की Trick 🧠

**"Be My Cat, Sir Baba Radha"**
- **Be**ryllium
- **M**agnesium
- **Ca**lcium
- **Sr**(Sir)ontium
- **Ba**(Baba)rium
- **Ra**(Radha)dium

accuracy.reason: The mnemonic accurately maps sequentially to the symbols and names of the six alkaline earth metals: Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, and Ra.
